dedupe_keys.name: syner g fragility curves for highway and railway infrastructure datos para resiliencia collection

description: This collection turns chapter 10 of the SYNER-G book, Fragility Functions of Highway and Railway Infrastructure by Sotiris Argyroudis and Amir M. Kaynia, into machine-readable seismic fragility curves for road and rail elements. Each curve is a lognormal cumulative distribution of an intensity measure, either peak ground acceleration in g or permanent ground deformation in metres, defined by the median and a dispersion parameter, and the collection records the damage states and the source reference of each curve. An index CSV lists the curves, and each curve is given as CSV, MATLAB and NumPy files, 112 files in all. It is published on the Datos para Resiliencia Dataverse (datospararesiliencia.cl) with a DOI. Coverage is generic: curves drawn from international literature as compiled in SYNER-G for road and rail elements. Access: free download under CC BY 4.0 (released October 2024). Caveats: the curves are literature values that should be checked against local construction practice, and descriptions are in Spanish. It supports seismic fragility and hazard exposure analysis of road and rail networks and resilience and cascading failure models, and complements the New Zealand State Highway liquefaction exposure dataset catalogued here.
